name: Kling AI
summary: Kuaishou's AI studio for video and image generation.
description: Kling AI is a creative studio from Kuaishou that turns text, images and reference material into videos and images. It is known for realistic motion and multimodal inputs combined in a single workspace aimed at creators and marketers. A free tier ($0) gives credits to try the models, while paid subscriptions add more credits, higher resolution and faster generation.
